_comment: Copy this file, fill in your genome paths, and pass it with: nextflow run main.nf -params-file my_params.json
//1.1: ── Protein database [optional; default downloads UniProt/SwissProt; engine diamond uses zenodo .dmnd, mmseqs2 uses raw_database FASTA; custom_database .dmnd/.dmnd.gz replaces diamond DB, .fa/.fasta is appended to raw_database] ────
//1.3: ── TransAID [optional; skip_transaid scores with the PREDICT model trained without TransAID features; keep the 0.1 cutoffs the bundled models were trained on] ────
//4: ── Output options [strip_truncations false keeps predictions iso-utr flags as 5' truncations, e.g. for annotation-grade input] ──────
